title: (0Day) (Pwn2Own) Alpine iLX-F511 Framework Service Exposed Dangerous Function Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Alpine iLX-F511 devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the framework service. The issue results from an exposed dangerous function. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
addtionnal_details:
02/05/26 - ZDI reported the vulnerability to the vendor06/07/26 - the vendor acknowledged the receipt of the report and asked for an extension07/21/26 - ZDI requested an update on the status of the fix10/15/26 - ZDI notified the vendor of the intention to publish the case as a 0-day advisory
-- Mitigation: Given the nature of the vulnerability, the only salient mitigation strategy is to restrict interaction with the product
